scope: Make authored mob, armor-piece, and pseudo-armor protection authoritative in the live armor recalculation cache, removing inherited NGE expertise, armor-set expertise, overridable protection, and entertainer build-a-buff resistance inputs without changing Publish 14.1 hit-location mitigation.

findings: The pinned Publish 14.1 combat manager selects the armor object at the resolved hit location and reads that object's authored rating and damage-type resistance.
Publish 14.1 applies PSG protection before the struck armor object, applies the weapon-versus-armor rating multiplier, and wears armor condition from incoming damage.
The pinned Publish 14.1 source contains no NGE expertise, armor-set expertise, overridable protection, or entertainer build-a-buff authority.

The retained armor recalculation helper is production-reachable on login, armor/cybernetic transfer, buff recalculation, faction changes, and battlefield vehicles; PRE-CU profiled creatures instead resolve their armor objvars directly on each hit.
